task_summary: Find fastening parts and tools, perform the fastening on the desk, and put tools back on the desk.

functional_roles.function: Provides the material connection between parts.
Applies force to secure the fastener.
The location or object receiving the fastener.
Flat surface where equipment is placed.
Tool used for the task, to be left behind.

functional_relations.relation: The fastener component must fit into the workpiece target.
The fastening tool acts on the fastener component to secure it to the workpiece target.

operation_pairings.operation: Search for and select the fastener and tool.
Drive the fastener into the target using the tool.
Place the used tool onto the desk surface.
